metadata.title: खरगोश का मीट | भील आदिवासी कैसे मीट पकाते हैं  | आदिवासी खाना | Rabbit Gravy | The Tribal Kitchen
metadata.description: In this episode of the Tribal Kitchen, two friends in a Bhil Adivasi village in Dungarpur, Rajasthan, prepared rabbit meat in a traditional Adivasi style. The rabbit meat was not only delicious but also known for its health benefits.
